description.value:
A line of small keratin barbs grafted along your knuckles and shins. Your unarmed Strikes lose the ability to deal nonlethal damage but change to 1d4 slashing and count as a light slashing weapon for anything that cares (runes on a handwrap, critical specialization, etc.).

Donor: A brawler. Their reflexes came with the barbs — you flinch into a guard you were never taught.

cinderfall.incomplete: Converting your existing unarmed Strike's damage type, die, and lethality all at once is too compound to safely automate: the base fist Strike is itself granted by a hardcoded rule (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/strike.ts:157-178) and no confirmed 'alter an existing granted Strike' rule element exists to redirect it rather than duplicate it.
